# ArchDaily

> ArchDaily is the world's largest architecture platform, broadcasting innovative design projects, news, and professional resources to a global community of architects and design enthusiasts.

ArchDaily serves as a comprehensive hub for architecture news, project showcases, educational content, and industry resources. The platform features curated articles, video tours, design awards, and a catalog of building products and BIM objects, making it essential for architects, students, and design professionals worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Architecture News
- Architectural Projects
- Building of the Year Awards
- Interior Design
- Residential Architecture
- Commercial Spaces
- BIM Objects
- Student Architecture Awards
- Design Showcase
- Building Materials
- Editorial Guidelines
- Project Submission
- Architecture Network
- Unbuilt Projects
- Featured Designs

## Core Platform

- [ArchDaily Homepage](https://www.archdaily.com): Main portal featuring architecture news, projects, and design awards with global coverage
- [About ArchDaily](https://www.archdaily.com/content/about): Platform mission, editorial approach, and information about ArchDaily's role in global architecture
- [ArchDaily Subscriber](https://www.archdaily.com/subscribe): Premium subscription plans offering exclusive features and partner benefits for members

## Content & Articles

- [Articles](https://www.archdaily.com/articles): Architecture articles, case studies, and design showcases from global contributors
- [Architecture News](https://www.archdaily.com/architecture-news): Latest architecture news, events, and Pritzker Prize coverage from around the world
- [Architectural Video Tours & Interviews](https://www.archdaily.com/videos): Video tours, interviews, and expert insights on architectural projects and design trends
- [Publications](https://www.archdaily.com/publications): Architecture publications, book reviews, and professional design writing from industry experts
- [ArchDaily Topics](https://www.archdaily.com/monthly-topics): In-depth monthly topics exploring pressing architecture issues and contemporary design debates

## Awards & Recognition

- [Building of the Year 2026](https://boty.archdaily.com): Annual Building of the Year awards showcasing exceptional architectural projects globally
- [ArchDaily Student Project Awards](https://www.archdaily.com/campus/awards): Student architecture awards recognizing emerging talent and innovative design projects

## Resources & Catalogs

- [Companies Catalog](https://www.archdaily.com/catalog/us/companies): Searchable catalog of architecture brands and building material suppliers worldwide
- [BIM Objects Directory](https://www.archdaily.com/catalog/us/bim): BIM objects and construction products directory for architects and design professionals

## Community & Engagement

- [Contact & Submit](https://www.archdaily.com/contact): Contact and project submission portal for ArchDaily contributors and collaborators
